citations.label: Park et al., Grammar-Aligned Decoding, NeurIPS 2024 (distortion)
citations.excerpt: In this paper we demonstrate that GCD techniques (and in general constrained decoding techniques) can distort the LLM's distribution, leading to outputs that are grammatical but appear with likelihoods that are not proportional to the ones given by the LLM, and so ultimately are low-quality.

citations.label: Park et al., Grammar-Aligned Decoding, NeurIPS 2024 (constrained decoding defined)
citations.excerpt: Constrained decoding approaches mitigate this problem by greedily restricting what tokens an LLM can output at each step to guarantee that the output matches a given constraint.
